mission_10: Congratulations on completing the Time Series Forecasting chapter! You have now built a comprehensive ensemble forecasting system that combines the strengths of multiple models into superior predictions. The simple average demonstrates that diversity alone can improve forecasts, while weighted and variance-weighted ensembles show how to leverage model-specific performance information. The median and trimmed mean ensembles provide robustness against poorly performing models, essential in production settings where model behavior can be unpredictable. The stacking approach you implemented learns optimal weights through gradient-based optimization, adapting to the specific characteristics of your data. Bootstrap aggregation not only improves point forecasts but also provides principled prediction intervals from the empirical distribution of bootstrap forecasts. Together with the nine previous missions covering ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, Transformers, seasonal decomposition, stationarity testing, multivariate forecasting, anomaly detection, and forecast evaluation, you now possess a complete, production-ready time series forecasting toolkit that spans classical statistics to modern deep learning.
